Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill because I wanted to experience the flavor of cooking over charcoal. What I got and discovered was so much more! Of course you can use this grill as a traditional charcoal grill but you can also use it as a smoker with no modifications required.
I found many YouTube videos of people using the Weber kettle to smoke all kinds of meats. All you need to do is set the charcoal to the side of the kettle for indirect cooking, add some wood for smoke and use the vents to control the temperature for low and slow smoking!
I've successfully smoked salmon, turkey, chicken, pulled pork, pork ribs, beef ribs, brisket. Even adding wood to give your traditional grilling some smoke flavor. One of the best steaks I've make was simply by using some hickory and the reverse sear method. I produced tender, perfectly cooked steaks with amazing smoke flavor that made me sigh with pleasure and satisfaction.

The kettle is well though out with the one touch cleaning system to remove ash. Sometimes is requires you to nudge the ash towards the cleaning wings but I have no complaints. 

This is my go-to grill for max flavor. I do have a Weber Genesys propane grill that I use when I can't wait for the charcoal to set up.
Results.Title: Versatile Grill and Smoker!

Results.ReviewText: I would give it 5 stars but the hook to hang the lid on the kettle is useless.  Very difficult to hang the lid and you can burn your forearm in the process.  Really bad design from several perspectives.  Then I notice that the grill one level up has a really nice hanger, even designed so the lid blocks the wind.  Tried to get the part, no can do.  Disappointing.
Results.Title: Lid hanger, bad design.

Results.ReviewText:
For the past 25 years, we've been using a Weber Genesis gas grill.  It was great, but 25 years is 25 years.  If we got another, we'd have to find a place for it in our wills, so we went for a charcoal grill.

I was a bit concerned by the reviews that said this thing is hard to assemble, but I find myself to be in disagreement with them.  This grill was easy to assemble, though one does have to do a bit of coaxing and pushing and twisting and begging to get the wheeled legs into their receptacles.  Weber provides a small plastic wrench for tightening some of the nuts, and the only other tools you need are a hammer (better - a rubber mallet) and a screwdriver.

The grill works great.  Keeps the Weber briquettes going, and I like that you can lift up the hinged edges of the grate to add more, which is great for long sessions.

We've been barbecuing with CNG and LP for a long time.  Almost forgot the great taste of charcoal grilled steaks.
Results.Title: Easy to assemble!

The only 'issue' I could see was the location of the temp gauge.  Really should be lower on the lid and closer to the vents.  But since I use a leave in probe thermometer it wasn't a big deal.  Clean up was super easy.  I would highly recommend a Weber kettle!

Results.Title: Super product

Results.ReviewText: Did not know what to expect, my first serious charcoal grill. I also bought the Weber Rapidfire chimney starter and this has been so awesome and easy to have real tasty charcoal bbq. I had gas grill and just never enjoyed the food cooked on gas. I’m very satisfied.

14407001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14407001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
